name: Beam

modes.label: Sandbox (CPU), per-ms on allocated cores + RAM
modes.note: $0.0000375/s per physical core (= 2 vCPU) -> $0.135/core-h = $0.0675/vCPU-h; RAM $0.0000064/GiB-s = $0.02304/GiB-h. Page example 1 core/8 GiB = $0.319/h. Machine start and image pull not billed. Billed until terminate() or keep_warm_seconds TTL expiry (idle tail billed; -1 = never). June-2026 rate was $0.19/core-h + $0.0202/GB-h. US default; EU/Asia placement on request. Basis verified 2026-09-28: "You are only charged when your containers are running." (https://docs.beam.cloud/v2/resources/pricing-and-billing). Sandbox keep_warm_seconds is a TTL (sb.update_ttl(300); -1 = "Manual termination only") (https://docs.beam.cloud/v2/sandbox/configuration), not an idle detector: auto_stop_idle = false for sandbox modes; serverless containers still scale down after keep_warm idle. CPU/RAM kept alloc.
modes.perf_source: ComputeSDK (github.com/computesdk/benchmarks results/): cold 105.06 ms (seq TTI 2026-08-07, runtime "node", SDK default size), burst 1,323.74 ms (2026-09-25), dax 64.89 s (2026-09-25, cpu:8 / 16 GiB; guest saw 96 host CPUs). No HPC CPU result.

modes.label: Sandbox with GPU (rate not published)
modes.note: GPU rates NOT published for sandboxes (pricing page 2026-09-28 lists serverless GPU and GPU machines only), so gpu prices are null and this regime is unpriced. Previously assumed = serverless GPU per-second rates (4090 $0.000192/s, 5090 $0.000303/s, H100 $0.000972/s; A10G $0.000292/s from June-2026 blog) plus GPU-attached CPU $0.000105/core-s and RAM $0.0000055/GiB-s. GPU concurrency 5 (Developer) / 50 (Team).

modes.label: Serverless function / pod (not a sandbox), 1/3 of sandbox CPU rate
modes.note: $0.0000125/core-s ($0.045/core-h) + $0.0000021/GiB-s. Billed incl. on_start and keep_warm_seconds (defaults: endpoints 180 s, task queues 10 s, pods 600 s). No sandbox exec/fs/snapshot API.

modes.label: BYOC management fee (compute billed by your cloud)
modes.commit_note: Book a call; your AWS/GCP/Azure instance cost is NOT included.
modes.note: $0.019/hr per vCPU (per vCPU, not per core) + $0.009/hr per GB RAM. Example g5.2xlarge 8 vCPU/32 GB = $0.44/h fee. Understates total cost: cloud VM bill is extra. Fee only: + your cloud bill (AWS/GCP/Azure instance cost not included; e.g. the underlying g5.2xlarge is billed by AWS separately).

knobs.label: keep_warm idle tail (x session hours)
knobs.why: Beam bills a sandbox until terminate() or until its keep_warm_seconds TTL expires, so an idle tail after the last command is billed at full rate (-1 = never expires; docs examples use 30 min-2 h). Factor = (session + TTL) / session; 1 = explicit terminate().

caveats: CPU is priced per physical core = 2 vCPU; vcpu_h is the per-core price / 2. The SDK's cpu= unit is undocumented (runtime shows millicores); if cpu=1 is 1 vCPU billed as a core, effective cost doubles.
Dated price change: Beam blogs of June 2026 quote sandbox CPU $0.0000528/core-s ($0.19/core-h) and RAM $0.0000056/GB-s; current page $0.0000375 and $0.0000064 (CPU -29%, RAM +14%).
Sandbox CPU/RAM are 3x the serverless container rate (alt mode). The page's cost calculator uses the serverless rate, not the sandbox rate.

free.monthly_credit set null (2026-09-28): the $30/month Developer credit appears on the 2026-08-29 Wayback capture of beam.cloud/pricing but not on 2026-09-12 or the live page; legacy-account entitlement unknown, so no credit is deducted. https://web.archive.org/web/20260829214155/https://www.beam.cloud/pricing , https://web.archive.org/web/20260912172148/https://www.beam.cloud/pricing
Idle keep_warm TTL tail is billed at full rate until expiry (sandbox examples 30 min-2 h; -1 never expires).
Snapshots (filesystem images and memory snapshots) included free; volumes free up to 1 TB then $0.021/GB-month; egress free.
Sandbox GPU pricing is not published; the sandbox-gpu regime is left unpriced (gpu rates null). On-demand GPU machine prices conflict between pricing page and docs GPU page (pricing page used).
Isolation: pricing FAQ says non-root containers; Beam's blog says gVisor; features file noted runc in CLI prompt. No root / systemd.
Max sandbox size and max lifetime unpublished. Region placement (EU/Asia) only by contacting Beam; no region multiplier published.
BYOC fee is per vCPU and excludes the cloud VM bill. Self-hosted beta9 (AGPL) has no Beam fee.
perf from benchmarks.json (computesdk cold start 105 ms, burst 1,324 ms, dax 64.9 s); no hpc CPU result.

unverified: may bill active CPU/RAM. Beam's sandbox docs say "You only pay for what you use. Start small and scale up as needed." but no page says whether billing uses requested or consumed cpu/memory; alloc (requested) assumed as the upper bound.
BYOC regime is a management fee only: add your own cloud bill (compute, storage, egress from AWS/GCP/Azure).

Sandbox root-filesystem size and price are not published (pricing/billing/sandbox-configuration pages re-checked 2026-09-28); only storage volumes are priced (free up to 1 TB, then $0.021/GB-month). Disk left unknown.

fleet.tiers: Developer: 30 CPU containers and 5 GPU containers; Team ($89/month): 1,000 CPU containers and 50 GPU containers; Growth: unlimited CPU and 1,000+ GPU containers via contact.
fleet.notes: default_max_instances refers to CPU-container concurrency. GPU-container allowance is not a GPU-unit quota, so default_max_gpus remains null. Team publishes a route to 50/300/1,000 CPU containers, subject to funding/capacity. No quota-increase turnaround stated.
